content:
Conversion debits USD principal and quota at execution and settles the CNY output after 10 minutes. A fee of 100 USD cents is taken separately from fee_balance_minor.

The output is amount_minor multiplied by 7, still in minor units. Receiving CNY in the account is distinct from withdrawing it to a bank beneficiary.

propose_cny_withdrawal consumes posted CNY and settles after 10 minutes without a second fee in CORE. Cancellation of an older reservation does not reverse quota expiry, and importing sales records creates quota without creating cash.
